label: TP
reason:
Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows to response.getWriter().println via bar = param.replaceAll("<[^>]+>", ""). The regex tag-stripping sanitizer is incomplete - it only removes angle-bracketed tags but does not encode special characters or handle all XSS vectors (e.g., encoded payloads, SVG event handlers, javascript: URLs). The resolved sink value is

+ tag-stripped user input +

, which can still contain executable content when parsed by browsers. This is a known limitation of simple regex sanitizers.

evidence.note: User input param flows through regex sanitize to response writer - incomplete XSS mitigation
